metadata.description: PaperBell agent skills: academic writing, vault conventions, manuscript formatting and vault migration. Generated from skills/*/skill.yaml by scripts/sync-marketplace.mjs — do not edit by hand.

plugins.name: claim-figure-ledger
plugins.description: Claim ledger (finding → evidence file → robustness → independent review verdict, deletions kept on record) and figure ledger (script, data, projection, compliance checks including China map rules and Nature sizes) as project cards with Bases views.

plugins.name: geo-dataset-cards
plugins.description: Build and audit CIMPO dataset cards (CRS, resolution, coverage, license, version, verification status, known pitfalls) and study-area cards from README and catalogue material, with a verify-before-use protocol.

plugins.name: geo-research-dashboard
plugins.description: One-way sync of per-project STATUS.md files (kept outside the vault by you or an AI coding session) into vault project cards, a dashboard Base and a "needs my decision" inbox.

plugins.name: paperbell
plugins.description: Write a manuscript in the PaperBell Markdown → Pandoc → xelatex export conventions, or convert an existing markdown document to them. Encoding only — never changes what the document says.

plugins.name: paperbell-academic-writing
plugins.description: Academic writing conventions and the PaperBell 5.x CIMPO vault structure, so the agent knows where literature, concepts, projects and drafts live and how a new draft links into them.

plugins.name: paperbell-migrate
plugins.description: Copies your personal notes from a PaperBell 4.6.1 vault into a 5.0.3 vault one folder at a time, after verifying a full backup of the old vault. The old vault stays read-only, the new vault keeps its defaults, every step is verified and recorded outside both vaults, and unmatched content is listed for you to decide.

plugins.name: paperbell-note-conventions
plugins.description: Frontmatter and template conventions for every PaperBell 5.x note type — concept cards, inputs, scholars, institutes, grants, diaries, projects and outputs.

plugins.name: spatial-analysis-checklist
plugins.description: Pre-review self-check for geospatial work across 12 reviewer-favourite topics (MAUP, UGCoP/NEAP, spatial autocorrelation, CRS, spatial-CV leakage, edge effects and more) with Crossref-verified references, plus method cards that copy published methods step by step and geo fields for literature notes.

plugins.name: tables-to-workbook
plugins.description: Put every table a manuscript needs into the project's one spreadsheet workbook — one sheet per table, registered with the source of its numbers — and leave only an xlsx-table pointer in the prose.

plugins.name: track-changes
plugins.description: Write review findings into a markdown draft as CriticMarkup beside the sentence they concern, and process the author's replies — without rewriting the author's prose.

plugins.name: geo-research-kit
plugins.description: Adapts a PaperBell vault to geospatial research — a read-only dashboard over project STATUS files, dataset and study-area cards with CRS/license/verification, a pre-review spatial-analysis checklist with method cards, and claim/figure ledgers with map compliance checks.

plugins.name: manuscript-formatting
plugins.description: The carrier layer for a PaperBell manuscript — export conventions, the one-workbook table discipline, and CriticMarkup review annotations that never survive to export.
